latest_release.body:
Desktop release 0.1.133

## 更新说明
### 🤖 模型与推理强度更准
Claude 订阅可选最新 Fable 5.2；Codex 里的 DeepSeek 续聊时，工具历史不再乱序。Subagent 沿用父任务的推理强度并显示实际值；手机分别记住远程模型强度与 Fast。 @BarneyZhaoooo @Br1efx @DavidShenXD @cursoragent @dashhuang

### 💻 供应商可指定运行电脑
远程供应商可以指定由自己的哪台电脑运行，模型列表里同一供应商只显示一条，新任务会跟随所选电脑。供应商组会分别列出每个订阅账号的用量和登录状态；用量热力图会按使用时长自动切换半年或全年。 @DavidShenXD @MagicLizi @dashhuang @zqchris

### 🔐 Windows 上 Codex 登录修复
修复 Windows 上 Codex 登录后被弄丢、换账号后串号的问题：Cindy 与本机 Codex 改为各自独立登录，不再共用一个登录文件。 @DavidShenXD @joei4cm

### ✈️ 飞书长回复完整送达
飞书里过长的回复会按段落分条完整发送并带页码，代码块和表格保持完整，不再被截断或提示去桌面端查看；一轮结束后可在答案上方展开本轮过程记录回看。被转发的卡片也不会再被静默丢弃。 @dashhuang @joei4cm

### 🌐 浏览器自动化更顺
需要浏览器时，Cindy 会自动启动你的浏览器并等待扩展连接，不用再手动打开。一次调用可以连续执行多步操作，遇到页面报错会立即停止并说明失败原因，不会继续执行后面的步骤。 @dashhuang

### 📱 iPhone 灵动岛与 Android 通知
iPhone 灵动岛会显示任务进度和未读结果，收起后点按可回到首页。Android 没有 Google 推送也能自动收到通知，部分失败不会丢消息；文件预览报错、群聊富文本崩溃和归档撤销位置也已修正。 @Br1efx @DavidShenXD @dashhuang @zqchris

### 💬 异步提问不丢草稿
需要你补充信息的问题可以异步回答，编辑多个问题不会互相覆盖，模型撤回后已写的内容仍会保留。回答输入框改为全宽，代输入与原生提问分开，停止任务后答案也不会被重新提交。 @dashhuang @zqchris

### 🪟 窗口与界面打磨
修复窗口贴满屏幕、半屏贴靠被误记成最大化，以及换屏或副屏断开后大小和位置错乱；关闭再打开侧边栏会回到原来的位置和宽度。透明显示效果已更新，跨消息复制不再带上时间、费用等正文外信息，多语言文案也已修正。 @Br1efx @DavidShenXD @dashhuang @kirozeng

### 🧩 Agent 协同、插件与技能
协同中，Lead 与 Worker 可查看并整理排队消息。插件列表返回后仍可滚动，未启用 Claude 时不建 ~/.claude 目录；新任务可设默认工作目录，worktree 可指定基线分支。 @97Three @DavidShenXD @GaoWeiLiuXD @dashhuang @fmfsaisai @joei4cm

English · 简体中文

Download Cindy  ·  Website  ·  Build with us  ·  Get help

★ GitHub Trending #1 · 2026.10.26

Cindy is an **open-source AI agent, ready out of the box and yours to shape**. Connect your computers and phone, bring the models and subscriptions you already use, and build a companion that knows how you like to work. ## All your devices. One Cindy. Your work computer, home desktop, laptop and phone belong together. - **Pick up the same work.** Open a session from another device, continue the conversation, and access its files without copying everything into a new chat. - **Share more than a screen.** Use model providers configured on another computer — including supported subscriptions, API providers and local models. - **Reach your whole desktop.** Built-in remote desktop on your phone lets you open apps, type and operate a connected computer when a chat isn't enough. Your computer becomes your server: **no server rental or self-hosting setup**.
How connections and data work For remote access to your computers, keep them online, sign in with the same account and enable the relevant permissions. Model sharing requires allowing remote access to that provider; remote desktop also needs its own permissions. Project files stay on their computer — remote access is not whole-disk sync. Cloud companions sync their conversations, memory, skills and shared attachments through Cindy's services; model providers process the requests sent to them. Provider and service billing still apply.
## Keep your favorite agents. Get a better way to work. Already using Claude Code or Codex? Cindy brings them together with **Pi**, then adds a shared interface, multi-device access, tools and a companion of your own. | Harness | What it brings | | --- | --- | | **Claude Code** | Claude Code's agent workflow, with Cindy's interface and connected tools. | | **Codex** | Codex's coding workflow, available alongside your other agents. | | **Pi** | A lean, open-source, extensible agent with support for multiple model providers. | Choose a supported harness and model combination, and change it as the work evolves. Your session stays in Cindy; switching harnesses hands off or rebuilds the engine context rather than making their internal states identical. **One agent not enough? Let her lead a team.** Use different agents for planning, parallel implementation and independent review, with a shared goal and clear acceptance criteria. ## Real work, in your actual tools Work with your files, browser and apps. Ask for a change, inspect what happened, and keep working from the result. Answers can include **charts, interactive controls and rich HTML**, not just a wall of text. Build a recurring routine with **automations**, or hand over work through connected chat channels such as Slack and Telegram. Connect more tools through **Skills, plugins and MCP**. ## Ready from day one. Yours to shape over time. - **Create your own companions.** Give them a role, instructions, skills and recurring work — a reviewer, researcher, project partner, or something of your own. - **Make experience reusable.** Keep useful preferences and knowledge in memory; turn a good way of working into a Skill you can reuse and share. - **Extend the product.** Discover Skills and plugins in SkillHub, connect your own tools, or build on the [official plugins](https://github.com/makecindy/cindy-official-plugins). - **Help shape Cindy.** Audit the code, fork it, improve an interaction, fix a bug, or contribute a useful integration. The client is Apache-2.0 licensed. Open source means more than visible — it means changeable. [Build Cindy with us →](CONTRIBUTING.en.md) ## Start with what you already have The **client is free**. Authorize a supported subscription you already pay for, including Claude Code or Codex plans, connect your own API keys, or use a local model. You can also use Cindy's managed model service. Provider limits and billing still apply; the free client does not mean unlimited model usage. **macOS · Windows · Linux · iOS · Android** [Download Cindy](https://cindy.app/download) · [Service pricing](https://cindy.app/pricing) Linux users: see the [Ubuntu, Arch Linux and Omarchy installation guide](docs/linux.md) for installation, updates, keyring setup and migration from a manual install.

A few people noticed.

Every star means something.

--- ## For developers This repository contains Cindy's open-source **desktop and mobile clients** and their shared packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo. ### What's in this repo | Path | Description | | --- | --- | | `apps/desktop` | Electron desktop client | | `apps/mobile` | Expo / React Native mobile client | | `packages/*` | Shared client capabilities (auth, device-link, agent orchestration, model providers, …) | | `apps/*-bin` | Tool binaries shipped with the desktop app; none are committed — claude-code, codex, and ripgrep are downloaded per platform by `pnpm install`, and the Android platform-tools binaries are fetched (pinned version, sha256-verified) before Windows packaging | **Not in this repo:** the backend service lives in a separate repository and is not part of this monorepo. | Mode | Account requirement | Availability | | --- | --- | --- | | Hosted service | Cindy cloud account | Use Cindy's full hosted service. See [pricing](https://cindy.app/pricing). | | Skip Sign-In | No Cindy sign-in required | Choose “Skip Sign-In” on the login screen to use local agents; the app then shows the account state as “Not signed in”. Server-backed capabilities are unavailable in this state. | ### Prerequisites - **Node.js** 22.x - **pnpm** 10.x (v11 is not yet supported) - **Git LFS** ### Getting started Contributor setup, Git LFS, dependency updates, and access requirements are maintained in [`CONTRIBUTING.en.md`](CONTRIBUTING.en.md). Plugins are installed through SkillHub or manually. Minimal entry point: ```bash git clone https://github.com/makecindy/cindy.git cd cindy git lfs pull pnpm install ``` ### Development entry points ```bash # Mainland China Cindy account pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=cn # Global Cindy account pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=global ``` Remote development uses your own Cindy cloud account and existing login state, so you can continue existing sessions and work while developing the client. Use `cn` for Mainland China accounts and `global` for everyone else; do not rely on the internal default. Full desktop, mobile, data-isolation, and validation workflows are in [`CONTRIBUTING.en.md`](CONTRIBUTING.en.md). “Skip Sign-In” on the login screen runs local agents without a Cindy account (shown in the app as “Not signed in”), not a connection to a local server. Server-backed capabilities are unavailable in this state. **About the default servers:** the client connects to Cindy's official cloud services by default (endpoint manifests in [`config/endpoint.json`](config/endpoint.json) and [`config/endpoint.global.json`](config/endpoint.global.json); desktop auto-updates also come from the official CDN). This is intentional — external developers don't need to self-host a server: sign in with your own Cindy account in a dev build and develop / test directly against the official servers. Skill Hub migration uses two separate manifest fields: released clients keep using `skillhubApiBaseUrl` (the deprecated XD proxy), while current clients use `cindySkillHubApiBaseUrl`. The current client deliberately does not fall back to the legacy field when the new endpoint is absent. ### Architecture - [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) — visual design system, color tokens, and UI conventions - [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md) — complete documentation and rules index - [`docs/auth-realm-routing.md`](docs/auth-realm-routing.md) — organization SSO region discovery and session endpoint routing - [`CONTRIBUTING.en.md`](CONTRIBUTING.en.md) — contributor setup, validation, and submission workflow - [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) — engineering rules, launch/runtime contracts, and module boundaries - [`docs/dev-rules/`](docs/dev-rules/) — deep-dive architecture docs (e.g. Orca multi-agent orchestration) ## Contributing Contributions go through pull requests into `main`. Read [`CONTRIBUTING.en.md`](CONTRIBUTING.en.md) first, then use [`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md). Every commit needs a [Developer Certificate of Origin](DCO) sign-off (`git commit -s`); a DCO check on each pull request enforces it, and no CLA is required. Please also follow [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.en.md`](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.en.md). For ordinary usage questions, see [`SUPPORT.en.md`](SUPPORT.en.md); report security issues privately through [`SECURITY.en.md`](SECURITY.en.md). ## Security Never commit credentials or authorization files to the working tree. If you discover a security issue, follow [`SECURITY.en.md`](SECURITY.en.md) to report it privately rather than opening a public issue. ## Privacy & telemetry **Official distribution builds** include [TapDB](https://www.taptap.io/tapdb) usage analytics for product-level aggregate statistics, including device identifiers, OS / app version, startup and activity events. Events are associated with your account ID after sign-in, so this is not fully anonymous. TapDB does **not** collect chat content, file content, or working-directory data. **You can disable usage analytics without editing code**: on Desktop, use Settings → About → Usage statistics; on Mobile, use Usage statistics in Settings. The SDK checks the stored privacy-consent state and the statistics preference, which defaults to on. Accepting the Privacy Policy records consent; a one-time migration also records consent for eligible existing signed-in users. **Known Mobile exception:** enterprise SSO skips the policy-acceptance step. If no analytics consent record exists and that sign-in is restored after restarting the app, the current migration can mark even a new installation as consented. With TapDB configured and statistics enabled, reporting can then start without explicit policy acceptance. See [Mobile sign-in restoration](apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx) and the [consent migration](apps/mobile/src/analytics/analyticsConsentStore.ts). Turning off Usage statistics prevents reporting from being enabled by this migration. - Desktop stops subsequent analytics reporting immediately when disabled. Local mode (Skip sign-in) does not report to TapDB. - Mobile immediately unlinks the account and stops reports explicitly triggered by Cindy. An already initialized native SDK cannot be uninitialized; fully quit and relaunch the app to keep the SDK uninitialized. Implementation: [Desktop consent and settings](apps/desktop/src/main/analyticsSettingsService.ts), [Desktop SDK](apps/desktop/src/renderer/analytics/tapdbClient.ts), [Mobile consent](apps/mobile/src/analytics/analyticsConsentStore.ts), and [Mobile SDK](apps/mobile/src/analytics/mobileTapdb.ts). Online heartbeats and diagnostic logs are separate mechanisms, unaffected by the usage statistics switch. Desktop sends heartbeats to Cindy services only during a verified cloud sign-in (account ID, platform, and version); local mode sends none. Desktop native crash dumps stay local and are never uploaded automatically. Diagnostic logs can be uploaded manually; a separate, default-off automatic crash log upload option is also available. Log uploads require privacy consent. See the [heartbeat implementation](apps/desktop/src/main/heartbeatService.ts) and [log upload rules](docs/dev-rules/log-upload-and-redaction.md). **Building from source?** You are not required to keep analytics: - Desktop development builds do not initialize TapDB by default. Explicitly setting `XDT_TAPDB_DEV=1` lifts the build gate but still requires consent and the statistics preference. Self-packaged Desktop builds use the same analytics gates as official builds; you can disable analytics in Settings. - Mobile does not initialize the SDK without injected TapDB configuration (`clientId` / `clientToken`). This does not mean all source builds default to off: the self-hosted release pipeline requires nonempty configuration, while local development permits empty values. See the [Mobile build guide](apps/mobile/docs/simulator-debugging.md). ## License / 许可证 Except as otherwise noted, the source code in this repository is licensed under the [Apache License, Version 2.0](LICENSE). Individual source files do not carry per-file license headers; the repository-root `LICENSE` governs. Model weights, datasets, prompts, trademarks, and other separately identified materials may be subject to their own license terms and are not automatically covered by the repository-level Apache-2.0 grant. Third-party open-source components retain their own copyright and license. Their attribution notices and SPDX SBOMs are managed under [`docs/legal/`](docs/legal/), with artifact-specific outputs in [`docs/legal/notices/`](docs/legal/notices/). See [`NOTICE`](NOTICE) for this project's copyright and attribution information.

★ GitHub Trending #1 · 2026.10.26

Cindy 是一个**开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent**。连接你的多台电脑与手机，把熟悉的 Agent、模型和已有订阅放在一起，培养一个懂你工作方式的伙伴。 ## 所有设备，同一个 Cindy。 办公室的电脑、家里的主机、随身笔记本和手机，连在一起用。 - **换屏幕，不换任务。** 在另一台设备打开同一个任务，继续对话、访问文件，不用重新搬运资料。 - **不只共享画面，也共享模型。** 其他电脑上配置好的订阅、API 供应商和本地模型，开启远程访问后也能调用。 - **手机，也是电脑的遥控器。** 内置远程桌面，需要时直接打开应用、输入和操作自己的电脑。 **你的电脑，变身免费的服务器，全球畅联。** 不用另租服务器，也不必自己搭服务。
连接与数据如何处理 远程访问自己的电脑，需要电脑在线、设备登录同一账号，并开启相应权限。 模型共享需要允许对应供应商被远程调用，远程桌面也有独立的授权与系统权限。 项目文件仍在原电脑上，可远程访问不等于整盘自动同步。云伙伴的对话、记忆、 自有 Skill 和共享附件会通过 Cindy 服务同步；模型供应商会处理发送给它的请求。 模型和服务费用仍按相应规则计费。
## 熟悉的 Agent，更顺手的体验。 已经在用 Claude Code 或 Codex？Cindy 把它们和 **Pi** 放在一起，再加入对交互、 多设备访问、工具协作的理解。 | Harness | 带来的能力 | | --- | --- | | **Claude Code** | 熟悉的 Claude Code 工作方式，接上 Cindy 的界面与工具。 | | **Codex** | Codex 的代码工作流，与其他 Agent 在同一个产品里配合。 | | **Pi** | 轻量、开源、可扩展，原生支持多种模型供应商。 | 在支持的组合中选择 Harness 和模型，随任务需要切换。任务仍留在 Cindy， 跨 Harness 时会交接或重建引擎上下文，并非把不同引擎的内部状态原样搬过去。 **一个不够？让她带队。** 把规划、并行执行和独立 Review 交给不同 Agent， 围绕同一个目标和验收标准一起开工。 ## 在真实工具里，把工作做完。 使用你的文件、浏览器和软件，从交办到检查结果，都在工作的现场。 回答也不只有文字：**图表、交互控件和丰富的 HTML 内容**，都能出现在对话里。 把重复的事情设成**自动化**，或者从接入的 Slack、飞书等聊天渠道交办。 通过 **Skill、插件和 MCP**，继续连接自己的工具与工作方法。 ## 一开始就好用，任你打扮，任你培养。 - **培养自己的伙伴。** 给她角色、指令、Skill 和日常工作：代码审阅、资料研究、项目跟进，都可以有专门的搭档。 - **让经验留下来。** 把偏好和知识留在记忆中，把有效的方法写成可复用、可分享的 Skill。 - **把能力接进来。** 从 SkillHub 发现 Skill 和插件，连接自己的工具，也可以从[官方插件](https://github.com/makecindy/cindy-official-plugins)开始开发。 - **一起打磨 Cindy。** 审计、fork、改进交互、修复问题，或者贡献一个有用的集成。客户端以 Apache-2.0 开源。 开源，不只是看得见，更是改得动。[一起打造 Cindy →](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## 用你已经有的，开始就好。 **客户端免费。** 授权已有的 Claude Code、Codex 等受支持订阅，接自己的 API key， 或者使用本地模型；也可以选择 Cindy 官方模型服务。已有订阅仍按供应商的限额和 规则使用，软件免费不等于模型调用无限量。 **macOS · Windows · Linux · iOS · Android** [下载中国大陆版](https://cindy.cn/download) · [下载国际版](https://cindy.app/download) · [中国大陆定价](https://cindy.cn/pricing) · [国际版定价](https://cindy.app/pricing) Linux 用户可参考 [Ubuntu、Arch Linux 与 Omarchy 安装指南](docs/linux.md)。

--- ## 给开发者 本仓库包含 Cindy 的开源**桌面端、手机端及其共享 packages**，以 pnpm monorepo 组织。 ### 本仓包含什么 | 路径 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `apps/desktop` | Electron 桌面客户端 | | `apps/mobile` | Expo / React Native 手机客户端 | | `packages/*` | 客户端共享能力（鉴权、device-link、agent 编排、模型供应商等） | | `apps/*-bin` | 桌面端附带的工具二进制，均不入库；claude-code / codex / ripgrep 由 `pnpm install` 按平台自动下载，Android platform-tools 在 Windows 打包前按 pin 版本下载并校验 sha256 | **服务端不在本仓库：** 服务端位于独立仓库，不属于本 monorepo。 | 使用方式 | 账号要求 | 可用范围 | | --- | --- | --- | | 远程托管 | Cindy 云端账号 | 使用 Cindy 的完整托管服务；[中国大陆定价](https://cindy.cn/pricing) · [国际版定价](https://cindy.app/pricing)。 | | 跳过登录 | 无需登录 Cindy 账号 | 在登录页选择「跳过登录」即可使用本机 agent 功能，应用内显示为「未登录」。依赖服务端的能力在该状态下不可用。 | ### 前置要求 - **Node.js** 22.x - **pnpm** 10.x（暂不支持 v11） - **Git LFS** ### 开始开发 开发者安装、Git LFS、依赖更新和权限说明统一见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件通过 SkillHub 或手动安装。 最短入口： ```bash git clone https://github.com/makecindy/cindy.git cd cindy git lfs pull pnpm install ``` ### 开发入口 ```bash # 中国大陆版 Cindy 账号 pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=cn # 国际版 Cindy 账号 pnpm restart:desktop:remote --region=global ``` Remote 开发会使用你自己的 Cindy 云端账号和现有登录态，因此可以继续已有的会话与工作。 中国大陆账号必须使用 `cn`，国际版账号必须使用 `global`，不要依赖内部默认值。完整的 桌面端、手机端、数据隔离和验证流程见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 登录页的「跳过登录」不是连接本地服务端，而是无需登录 Cindy 账号即可使用本机 agent；进入后应用内的账号状态显示为「未登录」。依赖服务端的能力在该状态下不可用。 **关于默认服务器：** 客户端默认连接 Cindy 官方云服务（端点清单见 [`config/endpoint.json`](config/endpoint.json) 与 [`config/endpoint.global.json`](config/endpoint.global.json)，桌面端自动更新 同样来自官方 CDN）。这是有意的设计——外部开发者不需要自建服务端，用 dev 构建登录自己的 Cindy 账号即可直接对着官方服务器开发和测试。 ### 架构 - [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) —— 视觉设计系统、颜色 token 与 UI 规范 - [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md) —— 完整文档与规则索引 - [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) —— 面向社区贡献者的环境、验证与提交流程 - [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) —— 工程规范、启动 / 运行时契约、模块边界 - [`docs/dev-rules/`](docs/dev-rules/) —— 架构深度文档（如 Orca 多 agent 协同） ## 贡献 改动通过 pull request 合入 `main`。请先阅读 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)，再按 [`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) 提交。 每个 commit 需带 [DCO](DCO) 签名（`git commit -s`），由 PR 上的 DCO check 校验； 不需要签 CLA。 同时请遵守 [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)；普通使用问题见 [`SUPPORT.md`](SUPPORT.md)，安全问题仍按 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。 ## 安全 任何凭证 / 授权文件都不得提交进工作区。发现安全问题请按照 [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) 的说明私下报告，不要开公开 issue。 ## 隐私与遥测 **官方分发的安装包**包含 [TapDB](https://www.taptap.cn/tapdb) 使用统计，用于 产品层面的汇总分析，包括设备标识、系统 / 应用版本、启动与活跃事件；登录后会 关联账号 ID，因此不应理解为完全匿名。TapDB **不采集**聊天内容、文件内容或 工作目录数据。 **无需修改代码即可关闭使用统计**：桌面端在「设置 → 关于 → 使用统计」，移动端在 设置页的「使用统计」关闭。SDK 检查本地记录的隐私同意状态和统计开关，统计开关 默认开启。同意《隐私政策》会记录同意状态；符合条件的存量已登录用户也会通过一次性 迁移记录为已同意。 **移动端已知例外**：企业 SSO 跳过协议勾选。如果本机尚无统计同意记录，并在重启应用后 恢复该登录态，当前迁移逻辑可能把新装用户也标记为已同意。在已配置 TapDB 且统计开启时， 即使用户未明确接受隐私政策，也可能开始上报。实现见 [移动端登录恢复](apps/mobile/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx)与 [同意状态迁移](apps/mobile/src/analytics/analyticsConsentStore.ts)。 关闭「使用统计」可避免该迁移放行统计上报。 - 桌面端关闭后立即停止后续统计上报；「跳过登录」的本地模式不上报 TapDB。 - 移动端关闭后立即解绑账号并停止 Cindy 主动触发的上报；已初始化的原生 SDK 不支持反初始化，需彻底退出并重新启动应用，才会保持 SDK 未初始化。 实现依据：[桌面端同意与开关](apps/desktop/src/main/analyticsSettingsService.ts)、 [桌面端 SDK](apps/desktop/src/renderer/analytics/tapdbClient.ts)、 [移动端同意状态](apps/mobile/src/analytics/analyticsConsentStore.ts)、 [移动端 SDK](apps/mobile/src/analytics/mobileTapdb.ts)。 在线心跳与诊断日志是独立机制，不受「使用统计」开关控制。桌面端仅在已验证的云端 登录态下向 Cindy 服务发送在线心跳（账号 ID、平台与版本号），本地模式不发送。 桌面端原生崩溃转储只保留在本地，不会自动上传；诊断日志可手动上传，另外有默认关闭的 「崩溃时自动上传」选项，上传均须通过隐私同意门槛。详见 [心跳实现](apps/desktop/src/main/heartbeatService.ts)与 [日志上报规则](docs/dev-rules/log-upload-and-redaction.md)。 **从源码自行构建**时不必保留统计： - 桌面端开发构建默认不初始化 TapDB；仅显式设置 `XDT_TAPDB_DEV=1` 才放开构建闸， 仍须满足同意与开关条件。自行打包的桌面版与官方包使用相同统计门槛，可在设置中关闭； - 移动端未注入 TapDB 配置（`clientId` / `clientToken`）时不会初始化 SDK。 这不等于所有源码构建都默认关闭：自建正式发布流程要求配置非空，本地开发允许留空， 见[移动端构建说明](apps/mobile/docs/simulator-debugging.md)。 ## 许可证 / License 除非另有说明，本仓库的源代码依据 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) 授权。 源文件不单独携带许可证头，统一以仓库根目录的 `LICENSE` 为准。 模型权重、数据集、提示词、商标，以及其他单独标识的材料，可能适用各自的许可条款， 不因根目录的 Apache-2.0 而被自动覆盖。第三方开源组件保留各自的版权与许可，其归属 声明与 SPDX SBOM 统一收口在 [`docs/legal/`](docs/legal/)；各分发产物的精确清单 见 [`docs/legal/notices/`](docs/legal/notices/)。本项目的版权与归属信息见 [`NOTICE`](NOTICE)。
